question.text: In the experiment of calibration of voltmeter, a standard cell of e.m.f. $1.1$ volt is balanced against $440 \mathrm{~cm}$ of potential wire. The potential difference across the ends of resistance is found to balance against $220 \mathrm{~cm}$ of the wire. The corresponding reading of voltmeter is $0.5$ volt. The error in the reading of volmeter will be:
